sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Psychotria viridis is a tropical shrub or small tree, reported to reach about 5 m. Its opposite elliptic to oblong leaves are commonly 5–15 × 2–5.5 cm. Small white flowers grow in terminal clusters; the rounded fruits ripen red to orange and are about 4–6 mm wide.

sections.title: Chemical composition and uses
sections.text: Studies report dimethyltryptamine (DMT) in the leaves. Kew records medicinal and food uses, but this is not an ordinary edible plant; no preparation or dosage is described here.
